alex: Quick async — filling in today's eng-sec standup. TL;DR: audits, vuln tickets, IAM/KMS rotation. See below for specifics.

maria: Done: ran container and image scans (Snyk + Trivy) across infra namespaces. Found 2 med in sidecar images (CVE-2024-xxxx). Created remediation PR #412 with pinned versions.

jordan: Blocker: I need read access to prod KMS key metadata to update rotation window. @taylor do we have the infra-iam PR (#418) reviewed or should I open a support ticket with cloud?

taylor: I opened infra-iam PR yesterday, pending @maria review. If it's blocking you I can escalate review. Also propose rotation window: 30d -> 90d for staging, keep 30d for prod for now.

sam: FYI I merged the IAM policy linter PR and added CI check. Starting remediation for CVE-2025-0001 in our logging lib — will do canary deploy before wide rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New deploy to staging completed at 1782056850 for service "kms-manager" — no failures.

alex: Compliance reminder: the external audit deliverable is due next Tue. @ops-team can someone confirm S3 log retention for prod is set to 7y? Gov customers asked for confirmation.

taylor: Confirmed: prod retention 7y, staging 1y. Policy snippet:
```
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle --bucket redwood-logs-prod --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"retain-7y","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":2555}}]}'
```

sam: Plan for today: finish patch for logging lib + create rollout doc. Canary scheduled on dedicated pool at 11:30 PT, will post results here.

maria: No blockers on audits. Scanner also flagged a few orphaned service-accounts; I posted the list and suggested cleanup steps in #help. I can take first pass cleanup tomorrow.

alex: Action items: Jordan — open support ticket if KMS access blocked; Sam — post canary checklist and results; Taylor — please merge infra-iam PR by EOD; Maria — update audit spreadsheet with the new findings. I'll sync with SRE after lunch. :eyes:
